name: Shy-Rotam
label: Quest
description: Shy-Rotam: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow traveler.

Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.
Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Shy-Rotam is bold and unforgiving; she will defend her kind with fervent enthusiasm.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven both your strength and your determination. Many more challenges await you, but I have already shown you as much as I am able.
